entities.name: Arabidopsis DEVIL 11
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana UniProt Q8S8S3; 87 aa.

Annotated as a small regulatory polypeptide associated with differentiation, growth, and development; proposed roles include limiting polar cell proliferation in lateral organs and coordinating trichome socket-cell recruitment/differentiation.
UniProt annotations include negative regulation of cell population proliferation and shoot system development; localization annotations include plasma membrane and nucleus.
Pfam DVL domain PF08137 detected at residues 61–79.
